records.title: Debt-to-income review
records.requirement: Review total monthly debt obligations against qualifying monthly income. A DTI above the program's standard threshold requires documented policy support or an applicable exception.
records.exceptions: Documented compensating factors may be relevant when the applicable policy permits an exception.
records.keywords: DTI debt income obligations exception compensating factors

records.title: Income documentation
records.requirement: Qualifying income should be supported by appropriate current income and employment documentation. Conflicting income evidence must be resolved before final underwriting.
records.exceptions: None stated in this synthetic policy record.
records.keywords: income employment paystub verification conflicting income

records.title: Assets and closing funds
records.requirement: Funds needed for the transaction should be supported by acceptable asset documentation and the source of funds should be reviewed when required.
records.exceptions: None stated in this synthetic policy record.
records.keywords: assets cash closing funds bank statement source

records.title: FHA debt review
records.requirement: Review borrower debt obligations and qualifying income under the applicable FHA underwriting rules. This synthetic record is only a demonstration.

records.title: Evidence and unresolved items
records.requirement: Material underwriting conclusions should be supported by borrower evidence, policy evidence, or deterministic calculations. Unresolved material items should remain conditions for human review.
records.exceptions: None stated in this synthetic policy record.
records.keywords: evidence citation unresolved conditions validation audit
